title: The Duel Begins
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: The Duel Begins as Frank Miller, then DAREDEVIL artist and writer, captures the clash of lightsabers and the twisted torsos of Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader on the steps of Cloud City's carbon-freezing chamber (front). From the Marvel comic itself, Al Williamson and Carlos Garzon devote nearly a full page to showing Luke Skywalker's approach to the floating capital of Bespin (back).
